request.speaker: Mira
request.text: Morning. Would you bring me the bread from the kitchen? We could have breakfast together.

accepted.speaker: Ren
accepted.text: I'll get it. It's on the kitchen counter, right?

reminder.speaker: Mira
reminder.text: The bread is on the kitchen counter, in the upper-right room.

offer.speaker: Ren
offer.text: Here's the bread. Shall we eat?

thanks.speaker: Mira
thanks.text: Thank you, Ren. It's nice having breakfast together.

quiet.speaker: Mira
quiet.text: That was a good breakfast. Maybe we can do this again sometime.
